_note: Seed data for the Phase 4 bracelet leaderboard. 59 characters, ALL re-read in one pass into .corpus/ and re-scored together, so every entry comes from the same fetch and the same model build. SOURCE: lostark.bible CHARACTER pages (https://lostark.bible/character/{NA|CE}/<name>), fetched WITH THE AUTHORIZATION TOKEN — the whole corpus is authenticated, not anonymous — read once each, strictly sequentially. Raid-statistics endpoints were NOT touched. The data is self-reported: it is whatever the owner's roster last synced to lostark.bible, not a verified snapshot. LOADOUTS: a character page carries one loadout per bible tab — most_recent_raid ('Raid Loadout'), most_recent_chaos_dungeon ('Current Loadout (Chaos Dungeon)') and, for some characters, raid_merged ('Estimated Raid Loadout'). The list is treated as OPEN. EACH loadout has its own items[] and therefore its own bracelet, so a character can wear a different bracelet in each. Every loadout that has one is decoded and scored here, in loadouts[]. chosenLoadout indexes the one the board ranks: the HIGHEST linesPct, ties going to the loadout bible draws, then raid > est. raid > chaos, then newest. The top-level grade/lines/rawStats/damagePct/linesPct mirror that chosen loadout. RENDERED LOADOUT: the page's own bracelet tooltip draws the loadout with the newest lastUpdated — on all 59 pages read, without exception — which is NOT always the raid one. Reading the rendered DOM alone therefore hands you the chaos-dungeon bracelet whenever a character ran chaos after their last raid. renderedLoadout indexes it; its decode is validated line by line against bible's own words (bibleLines) — all 59 pages validate clean, every line, every number — and biblePct / biblePctDelta compare against THAT loadout, since bible's 'Bracelet Effects +X%' describes it too. PROFILE: every entry and every loadout carries the ARCHITECTURE §1.1 block, read off the same page by worker/bracelet.js's parseCharacterProfile — the six honing levels, the necklace's additional damage, both earrings' weapon power, the gem level (and the whole spread), the 9/7 ability stone, the Master ark-passive node and the character's combat power. It is what fills the calculator's left column when a seeded character is loaded, so a seeded load and a live pull now leave the deck holding the same thing. The block belongs to the LOADOUT — a chaos tab can wear other accessories and other gems than the raid tab — and the entry's copy mirrors the chosen loadout's. A field the page did not carry is ABSENT, never a default: `missing` lists what could not be read and `raw` holds the unsnapped readings behind each snapped one. combatPower is the page header's estimatedMaxCombatPower, not the loadout's own equipped snapshot, which runs low on a chaos tab; the loadout's figure is kept beside it as raw.loadoutCombatPower. SCORING: model/bracelet.js on the CANONICAL DEFAULT profile, normalizeProfile({}) — no per-player knobs. The profile block above is DATA, not a scoring input: nothing in it moves a board number. damagePct = whole bracelet: traitDamage(traits) for the combat-trait lines PLUS setDamage(lines) for the effect lines. setDamage returns 0 for a trait line, so the trait term is not optional. linesPct = effect lines only, the figure comparable to lostark.bible's own 'Bracelet Effects +X%' (biblePct) and to the 7-9% good / 10%+ near-final benchmark. goldAt1_5M = damagePct x 1,500,000 gold per 1% damage, baseline 0. ROLLS: numRerolls / numTicketRerolls in the payload are the counts USED, not left — 4 and 3 mean a fully-rolled bracelet. rollsRemaining = 4-base / 3-ticket, and matches bible's rendered 'N+M rolls remaining' on every page that prints it. rerollsLeft keeps its historical name and its historical value (the used counts) so the Worker's /admin/seed reader keeps mapping it onto numRerolls unchanged. KNOWN GAP: linesPct runs above biblePct across the board, and the 15 bracelets carrying family 14 (Additional Damage / Demon-Archdemon) sit about 2.3pp lower than the rest because the default profile sets demonShare=0 while bible appears to value that clause at full uptime. The residual offset that remains once family 14 is set aside is measured and dissected in docs/research/scoring-gap.md. DECODE: every type:2 index on all 59 pages is in the model's TYPE2_INDEX, and every type:3 / type:4 index decodes — the model now covers both blocks: the damage families 11-33 (internal n = 1-23) and the ten utility families 1-10, which sit at internal n = 26-35, i.e. family = n - 25. Nothing on any of the 59 pages needs a local override any more.
_loadoutRule: chosenLoadout = highest linesPct; ties: rendered, then raid > raid_merged > chaos, then newest
